csv_project_name: CMAR for Two Rivers - Bob Thomas Memorial District Park
csv_scope_of_work: Pasco County (County) requests proposals for a Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) to provide preconstruction and construction services for the Bob Thomas Memorial District Park at Two Rivers project (Project) in Pasco County, Florida. These services will be coordinated with an architectural and engineering consultant (the Design Professional) through the design and construction phases of the Project. This Project is to design and construct a new district park on three parcels (numbers 28-26-21-0000- 00100-0150, 28-26-21-0000-00300-0020, and 28-26-21-0000-00100-0021), for a combined total of approximately 85.86 acres. The Project is located off of State Road 56, just west of Gall Boulevard in Zephyrhills, Florida. The work on the Project will be expected to take into consideration the planned school on the adjacent property. The Project will serve as a new recreation hub for the County and provide a variety of high-quality recreation activities for users of different ages, genders, interests, RSQ-KF-26-040 Page 2 of 9 and desired activity levels. The project design should inspire inclusivity and equitability by adopting an Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)-compliant design, while also incorporating sustainable design to minimize the impact to the existing environment.
